lines.text: Did you know? Form is Latin for shape.
Formula: a small shape, a set pattern.
Quick quiz! Which means into plus shape?

words.mean: a small shape, a set pattern
words.ex: Learn the formula for the area of a circle.
You can find more information on our website.
